question: For every seed that contributes at least one in-zone paid observation, is the number of in-zone contacts explained by a named structural closure, and which closure is it - a zone disjoint from every promotion source, a source square with no reachable allowed destination, or the legal-safety filter?
why_now: The supervisor flagged seeds 61 and 72 as an unresolved residual needing a new endpoint. Stage 10 (disjointness), Stage 11 (source classification) and Stage 12 (played classes) each stored per-seed rows, so the question can be settled by re-reading them; no scan, no replay, no search and no new game are permitted for this stage.

inputs.results_zone_promotion_disjointness.json: per-seed zone squares, promotion-source squares and in_zone_paid_observations
inputs.results_stage12_contact_choice.json: per-seed contact counts by played class

method: join the three stored files by seed, re-derive the global bucket totals from the per-seed rows, and assign each seed exactly one closure class by the rule below
closure_rule: if the seed has no in-zone paid observation: closure 'no_in_zone_observation'
else if stage 10 says the seed's zone is disjoint from every promotion source: closure 'zone_disjoint_from_every_promotion_source'
else if the seed has at least one contact: closure 'contact_observed'
decision_rule: every seed with at least one in-zone paid observation is either 'contact_observed' or has a named structural closure -> decision 'every_zero_contact_seed_has_a_named_structural_closure'; otherwise decision 'unexplained_zero_contact_seed_remains'
reconciliation_checks: per-seed contact counts sum to 53, the published Stage 12 total
per-seed bucket counts sum to each published Stage 11 global bucket
the set of seeds with in-zone observations agrees between Stage 10 and Stage 11
cost: seconds; three JSON files read, no compute
consumer: the next research choice, which must decide whether a contact-based endpoint can be extended by more games on the zero-contact seeds or whether the binding constraint is destination reachability rather than zone geometry
nonclaims: a closure class explains why a contact could not occur in that seed, it does not value the zone term
no in-zone-versus-outside rate is produced and the withdrawn 0-vs-53 contrast stays excluded
no strength, playing-quality, utility or causal claim
re-reading three files written by the same scripts is bookkeeping, not independent measurement
